name: Dumbbell Row Bilateral
instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Row Unilateral
instructions: Brace your off arm against something stable (bench, box). Stagger your stance so your leg on the side of your working arm is back.
Try to get your torso to parallel with the ground. That will extend your range of motion.
Let your arm hang freely and then pull your elbow back. Imagine you've got a tennis ball in your armpit and squeeze it each rep.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Grab a dumbbell and hold with both hands. Point your dumbbell at the ceiling.
Flex at the shoulder joint while keeping your elbows mostly extended.
Flex until you feel a stretch in your lats then bring the dumbbell back to the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row
instructions: The dumbbells should be set on the ground. Hinge forward while keeping a flat back.
Pull one elbow back toward the ceiling and then return the dumbbell to the ground softly.
Then pull with the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Row
instructions: Place one hand and one knee on a bench. Make sure you keep a flat back.
Pull the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Make sure to avoid any jerking or rotating.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
instructions: Lay on an incline bench that is between 30-45 degrees high.
Let your arms hang freely. Pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
instructions: The dumbbells should be placed on the floor.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grab the dumbbells.
Pull both dumbbells back and your elbows toward the ceiling.
Return the dumbbells back to the floor softly on each rep.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Extension
instructions: Start by hinging over with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly bent.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row
instructions: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
instructions: Start by placing your elbow on one knee.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, with your palm facing inwards towards your body.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.

name: Lawnmower Row
instructions: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on a bench/box. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
instructions: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on your knee. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Supinated Row
instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, maintain an underhand grip, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Pushup to Renegade Row
instructions: Start in a high plank position with a pair of dumbbells positioned under your shoulders. Your hands should grip the dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you row one dumbbell up towards your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups
instructions: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Pull Ups
instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Grab dumbbell from floor with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower dumbbell fully back to the floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower dumbbell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull dumbbell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping movement controlled.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding dumbbell under shoulder with arm extended.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.
